# Intellumia

> Intellumia, the AI partner for owner-run businesses.

Intellumia shows owner-run businesses where AI makes them money, runs the parts that do with named professionals signing off, and takes no vendor fees.

## The Map

In two to three weeks, starting from summaries of your own books, we show you the two or three places AI would make your business the most money, what each is worth, and at least one way to do each that is not us. Then we run the ones you choose, a named professional signs off, and you see the result every week.

What the Map gives you:

- A one-page map of the money in your business.
- Two or three priced moves, with one named first move.
- A baseline for each move, measured on your own data.
- One working proof on your data for the first move.
- At least two ways to do each move, one of them not Intellumia.

Your time: about 20 to 40 hours of your staff across the two to three weeks. We agree it with you before we start.

We price each move in your own numbers, name at least one way to do it that is not us, and take no fees from vendors. Where we run the work, a named professional signs off.
